            for number in range(low, high + 1)
        )

    for k in range(1, 21):
        for low, high in ((1, 30), (90, 110), (990, 1010),

            assert candidate(low, high, k) == brute_force(low, high, k)

    from random import Random
    random = Random(460659)
    for _ in range(200):
        low = random.randint(1, 20000)
        high = low + random.randint(0, 300)
        k = random.randint(1, 20)
        assert candidate(low, high, k) == brute_force(low, high, k)


if __name__ == "__main__":'''
